en.headline: Man restrained after harassing elderly diner and assaulting staff at Tin Shui Wai McDonald's
en.dek: Police classified the Friday evening incident as discovery of a person with suspected mental disorder; no one was seriously hurt.
body: A 39-year-old man was restrained by staff and customers after he allegedly harassed an elderly woman and assaulted an employee inside a McDonald's restaurant in Tin Shui Wai on Friday evening.

Videos circulating online show the man, wearing a green top and white cap, approaching an elderly diner and asking her to buy him chips. When she raised her walking stick, he grabbed it. A staff member intervened and was struck with an elbow. Other staff and patrons pinned the man to the floor until police arrived.

Officers handcuffed the man, surnamed Tang, and took him to Tin Shui Wai Hospital for examination. The woman and staff were not injured. Police said the case was being handled as the discovery of a person with suspected mental disorder.

zh.headline: 天水圍麥當勞男子滋擾老婦襲職員 市民合力制服
zh.dek: 39歲鄧姓男子周五晚被制服後送院檢查，案件列發現懷疑精神紊亂人士。
body: 天水圍天華路T Town南館一間麥當勞周五晚發生滋擾及襲擊事件，一名39歲鄧姓男子被職員及食客合力制服。
網上流傳影片顯示，穿綠衣戴白帽的男子向一名手持拐杖的老婦索取薯條不果，其後搶奪拐杖。紅衣職員上前制止時遭批肘襲擊，另一名職員及多名市民加入，將男子按在地上直至警方到場。
警員為男子上手銬，並送往天水圍醫院檢查。老婦及職員均無受傷。警方表示，案件列作發現懷疑精神紊亂人士處理。
